statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (W : WeierstrassCurve k) [W.IsElliptic] {β : W.toAffine.Point →+ W.toAffine.Point}, β ∈ WeierstrassCurve.rationalHomSet k W W → ∀ (t q : ℤ), β.comp β + q • AddMonoidHom.id _ = t • β → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → (p : ℤ) ∣ q → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ t → ∃ T : W.toAffine.Point, T ≠ 0 ∧ p • T = 0

nodes.title: Main theorem
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (W : WeierstrassCurve k) [W.IsElliptic] {β : W.toAffine.Point →+ W.toAffine.Point}, β ∈ WeierstrassCurve.rationalHomSet k W W → ∀ (t q : ℤ), β.comp β + q • AddMonoidHom.id _ = t • β → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → (p : ℤ) ∣ q → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ t → ∃ T : W.toAffine.Point, T ≠ 0 ∧ p • T = 0

nodes.title: A prime divisor of a finite kernel produces a nonzero torsion point
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : A →+ A) [Fintype f.ker] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∣ Fintype.card f.ker → ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ f a = 0 ∧ p • a = 0

nodes.title: An irreducible monic quadratic excludes integer scalar relations
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] [CharZero R] (f : R) (t q : ℤ), f ^ 2 - (t : R) * f + (q : R) = 0 → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → ∀ c e : ℤ, c ≠ 0 → (c : R) * f ≠ (e : R)

nodes.title: Dual product identities uniquely determine trace and norm
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] [CharZero R] (f g : R) (t q d e : ℤ), f * g = (d : R) → (1 - f) * (1 - g) = (e : R) → f ^ 2 - (t : R) * f + (q : R) = 0 → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → f + g = (t : R) ∧ d = q
